findings.detail: The extracted row Associations, Inc. 1 has cost -4000, but the source row's cost cell is a dash; the negative value appears to come from the footnote marker (4).

rationale: C107 flags negative cost values. Some flagged negatives are source-disclosed parenthetical amounts, but the Associations, Inc. row with maturity 7/3/2028 and interest rate 10.66% is not: the SOI row shows footnotes (4) (5) (6), par amount 775, and dashes in the cost and fair value columns. The extracted cost of -4000 is therefore a real localized extraction error, likely footnote (4) leaking into the cost field.
